profile.headline: Client Services | Healthcare Operations | Technical Support & Systems
profile.summary:
I’m an operations and client services professional with experience across healthcare, technical field operations, and time-sensitive client logistics.

My background includes coordinating patient services, managing sensitive information and EHR documentation, troubleshooting digital tools, supporting clients, and adapting to changing operational requirements. I also have formal training in full-stack web development, giving me a strong technical foundation and the ability to learn new systems quickly.

I’m currently focused on opportunities in healthcare operations, patient/client services, technical support, application support, and systems-oriented operations where I can combine communication, problem-solving, organization, and technical skills.

I’m especially interested in roles where I can continue building my technical capabilities while contributing directly to customers, patients, teams, and day-to-day operations.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, built, and deployed scalable web applications and landing pages for small businesses using modern full-stack technologies.

• Developed responsive frontends using React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Built backend APIs with Node.js and Express, handling authentication and data logic
• Integrated third-party APIs and Firebase for real-time data and user authentication
• Managed state and asynchronous operations using React hooks and Axios
• Deployed apps with GitHub, Vercel, and Netlify; maintained version control with Git
• Created custom landing pages tailored to client branding and goals
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · GitHub · Troubleshooting · Node.js · React.js · Software Development · Customer Support · SQL · MongoDB · Firebase

positions.title: Licensed Real Estate Salesperson
positions.description:
Applied digital marketing strategies and CRM tools to connect renters with apartments in fast-paced NYC markets.

• Developed lead pipelines using digital listings and client outreach tools
• Conducted needs-based assessments to match clients with properties
• Negotiated lease terms and maintained clear communication across all stakeholders
• Balanced multiple clients and schedules while managing documentation and follow-ups
positions.insights: Skills: Sales · Trend Analysis · Client Onboarding · Digital Strategy · Communication

positions.title: Transcriptionist
positions.description:
Transcribed audio and video content into accurate written documents in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Maintained 98%+ accuracy rate across diverse topics and accents
• Applied grammar, formatting, and style standards to transcripts
• Balanced speed and quality while meeting daily quotas
positions.insights: Skills: Organization Skills · Attention to Detail · Customer Support · Transcription

positions.title: Swim Instructor
positions.description: Skills: Customer Service · Customer Support · Teaching · Lesson Planning

positions.title: Care Navigator
positions.description:
Served as a point of contact for patients in chronic care programs, coordinating services across departments.

• Used electronic health record (EHR) systems to track patient data and follow-up needs
• Supported clients by troubleshooting insurance, scheduling, and access issues
• Partnered with medical staff to deliver personalized care plans
positions.insights: Skills: Care Coordination · Customer Support · Chronic Care Management

positions.title: Emergency Medical Technician
positions.description:
Provided emergency medical care and transportation to patients in high-pressure environments.

• Assessed patient conditions, administered CPR, AED, and basic interventions
• Communicated vital information to hospital staff and dispatch
• Documented medical events and patient outcomes under strict protocols
positions.insights: Skills: Spanish · Automated External Defibrillator (AED) · Emergency Medical Services (EMS) · Problem Solving · Customer Support · Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) · Documentation · Emergency Medicine

projects.title: CodiGo-Space eCommerce Store
projects.description: CodiGo-Space is an eCommerce store built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Commerce.js, and Stripe API. This platform hosts a variety of tech products essential for tech enthusiasts. Users can browse through items, add them to the cart, and securely complete purchases using the Stripe API.
